stageModules.name: 索雷博 PT1/M 位移小面包板

nativeFrames.datumDescription: Two original manufacturer base mounting counterbores retain 25.4 mm pitch and measured axes (+/-12.7, 0) in preserved R1 imported assembly XY, translated Z -12.5 mm. CAD pose is not physical midtravel calibration.

Original 16 manufacturer M6 top threads retain actual CAD-measured XY coordinates enumerated below, based on 12.4968 mm array spacing, in preserved R1 imported assembly XY translated Z -12.5 mm. Native top is Z=20.32 mm. Neither nominal drawing rounding nor the exact 12.5 mm output-board grid replaces these native axes; source pose is not physical midtravel calibration.

reviewLimits: Nominal fit and temporary envelope checks in saved source pose only; no automatic precision location from clearance screws.
Native base bores remain +/-12.7 mm. Runtime lowerAttachmentHoles are +/-12.5 mm host-thread and screw axes, not a redefinition of manufacturer geometry.
Install bare stage first at a position exposing the two factory top access holes; then attach PT1-T. Reverse order for disassembly. PT1-T blocks bottom fastener tooling.
Full OEM moving/fixed internal grouping and all-travel tool access were not reconstructed; imported pose is not physical midpoint calibration.
Actual thread depth, clamp load/bearing pressure, tightening torque, board flatness, height tolerance, centering and useful full travel require physical acceptance.

tableAttachment.locationMethod: Clearance clamping; align physical stage travel center and top grid with an external jig/measurement before final tightening
tableAttachment.hostThreadDepthRequirement: Actual usable M6 thread depth must cover nominal 5.428 mm projection plus actual screw-length/entry allowance, without screw bottoming. Recommend at least 8 mm usable thread depth subject to real host inspection; no load rating is asserted.

runtime.baseBoundsEvidence: OEM bottom-contact footprint measured from unchanged factory CAD; no PT1-B; frozen independent direct-mount audit.

同轴孔与名义旋入校核不等于所有螺钉可放入/工具可达。
本包不修改厂家源模型或绕过供应商限制。
